claims.text: Intralesional triamcinolone (eg, 0.1 mL of 2.5 mg/mL; dilute the 10 mg/mL suspension) for firm cystic or nodular lesions when quick improvement is wanted; local atrophy may occur but is usually transient
claims.quote: Intralesional glucocorticoid injections (eg, 0.1 mL triamcinolone acetonide suspension 2.5 mg/mL [the 10 mg/mL suspension must be diluted]) is indicated for patients with firm (cystic) acne who seek quick clinical improvement with reduced scarring. Local atrophy may occur but is usually transient.
